'''Tagoo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Patitite/Legends|Patitite]] [[Scout/Legends|scout]] and warrior during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
With fellow scout [[Jimba/Legends|Jimba]],<ref name="Nomad Droids" /> Tagoo<ref name="Guide">{{SW|url=explore/the-clone-wars/ep406|text="Nomad Droids" - ''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide|nolive=1}}</ref> led a hunting party after the [[Droid/Legends|droids]] [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] and [[R2-D2/Legends|R2-D2]], who crash landed on [[Patitite Pattuna/Legends|Patitite Pattuna]] in a [[BTL-B Y-wing starfighter/Legends|BTL-B Y-wing starfighter]]. Tagoo and Jimba led the attack on the droids and overpowered them with their [[Powered spear/Legends|Powered spears]]. With the droids captured, the Patitites called their leader, the Big [[Hay-Zu/Legends|Hay-Zu]], to question him on what they should do with the droids. However, when the Big Hay-Zu was crushed to death by R2 on accident, Tagoo and the other Patitites cheered. Along with Jimba, Tagoo requested that C-3PO stay to be their new leader. He refused however, and instead helped them set up a democracy. The two droids left, leaving the Patitites to quarrel over future leadership.<ref name="Nomad Droids" />

==Behind the scenes==
Tagoo was voiced by [[Matthew Wood]] in the episode "[[Nomad Droids]]."<ref name="Nomad Droids" />
